purpose: Teach: フロイト/語りかけ/サーカス/サイレン/培っ/エディタ/必殺/イースター

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、心理学のフロイト、本気で、絶対、彼、絶対、勉強してるって、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Aoi, you're seriously dedicating yourself to studying Freud. I really admire that.
lines.style: Warm admiration, slightly surprised. Gentle opening. Steady, thoughtful pace. Eyes soft with genuine respect.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵で、本気で、絶対、お客様、絶対、心に、絶対、語りかけるような、絶対、音楽、絶対、流してるよ
lines.en: Yeah. I pick music for the café that really speaks to customers' hearts, you know?
lines.style: Modest but sincere. Soft voice, not deflecting but not seeking praise either. A small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、本気で、絶対、サーカス、絶対、街、絶対、やって来たわよね、葵、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、見に行きたい
lines.en: You know, a circus came to town recently — I've been dying to go. Want to come with me?
lines.style: Bright anticipation. Lifted energy, leaning forward slightly. The invitation wrapped in genuine enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夜中、本気で、絶対、消防車のサイレン、絶対、聞こえたわよ、葵で、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、心配
lines.en: I heard a fire truck's siren in the middle of the night. I was worried it might've been something serious.
lines.style: Careful, thoughtful. Genuine concern underneath. Not alarmed, but present. A pause before speaking.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、経験を、絶対、培ってきた、絶対、お店、絶対、本当に、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: Aoi, the way you've built up your café experience — it's really impressive. You should be proud.
lines.style: Sincere, steady admiration. Speaks as though stating something obvious and true. No performance, just recognition.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、テキストエディタ、絶対、最新のを、絶対、買ったわよ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、便利
lines.en: I picked up the latest text editor software. It's going to make things so much easier.
lines.style: Pleased, practical tone. A hint of quiet satisfaction. Not boastful—just sharing something useful that'll help.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お店、本気で、絶対、必殺の新作、絶対、出してね、葵、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、楽しみ
lines.en: I'm working on a special new menu for the café. I'm really excited to show you what I've come up with.
lines.style: Warm anticipation, slight lift in energy. Gentle confidence. The excitement of sharing something you've made with care.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: イースター、本気で、絶対、葵で、絶対、特別メニュー、絶対、出すわよ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、楽しみよね
lines.en: For Easter, I'm planning to do a limited special menu. I really hope you'll come by and try it.
lines.style: Warm, intimate invitation. Softer pace toward the end. The kind of offer made to someone you want to see enjoy something.
